Your data stays only on your own phone and is only sent to servers you configured yourself. We do not collect, upload, or share any of your personal information.

Pairing keys (Secret), cloud API Keys, and account IDs are kept in the phone\'s local encrypted storage; if encryption fails, writes are refused and never fall back to plaintext. Session lists, chat history, server addresses, and reconnect sequence numbers are kept in local regular storage. All of the above can be fully deleted via \"Clear app data\" or by uninstalling the app.

This app only connects to servers you entered yourself (self-hosted Relay, desktop Agent, cloud OpenCode). Chat content and file browsing results travel only between your phone and your servers, never through any third party. We have no account system, no analytics SDK, and no ad SDK.

Camera: only for scanning pairing QR codes. Notifications: task completed/failed/pending-approval alerts. Foreground service & wake lock: keep the long-lived connection (can be turned off). Network state: detect disconnections. Vibration: notification alerts.
"Check for updates" queries the public GitHub API for the latest version info; only the app version number is transmitted, no personal information.
If you enable crash reporting, a redacted stack trace (no chat content or keys) is sent on crashes to help fix bugs. Off by default.

[SSL certificate troubleshooting]\n1. If using a self-signed certificate, install the root certificate in the Android system credentials, or switch to a free trusted Let\'s Encrypt certificate;\n2. If Cloudflare SSL is configured, confirm the SSL/TLS mode is set to Full (Strict) or Flexible.

[Timeout troubleshooting]\n1. Check whether the target IP/port is blocked by the cloud provider\'s security group;\n2. If using a domestic tunnel (SakuraFrp/frp), confirm the network between the tunnel client and server is fine.
